claim: Creates a point-in-time Kubernetes RBAC packet with causal grant evidence.
sandbox: Run kpe demo in a new temporary directory and inspect the generated Markdown and JSON.

claim: Collection invokes only the documented kubectl commands.
sandbox: Use a controlled kubectl executable that records every argument and returns Kubernetes-shaped fixtures.

claim: Evaluates exactly the questions in a bounded access matrix and rejects unknown fields.
sandbox: Compare the bundled packet with its matrix, then submit a misspelled apiGroup field and require failure.

claim: Records every matching binding and rule for an allowed check.
sandbox: Evaluate a fixture with two independent grants and assert both causal paths appear.

claim: Collection makes no Kubernetes mutation.
where: first screen, README, and privacy page
sandbox: Record all controlled kubectl calls and reject any mutating verb.

claim: Kubeconfig bearer tokens are not copied into snapshots.
sandbox: Collect through a controlled kubectl with a sentinel token in kubeconfig and inspect the snapshot.

claim: The CLI runs as one process, installs no cluster component, and never overwrites a demo directory.
where: landing page, demo guide, and README
sandbox: Run the bundled demo with no kubectl, inspect its temporary files, and require failure for an existing directory.

claim: The CLI and site send no telemetry.
where: landing page, README, and privacy page
sandbox: Run the CLI demo without external tools and record every browser request during the site demo.

claim: The bundled demo and website do not use a hosted cluster connection.
sandbox: Run kpe demo with an empty PATH and exercise the browser demo while recording external requests.

claim: Saved snapshots can be evaluated without kubectl or a cluster.
sandbox: Run report against bundled files with an empty PATH and inspect the result.

claim: Writes matching Markdown and JSON evidence files.
sandbox: Run the bundled report into a temporary basename and inspect both outputs.

claim: JSON mode writes the complete report to stdout without creating output files.
sandbox: Run JSON mode in an empty temporary directory and compare the directory before and after.

claim: Evaluation uses exit 0, input failures use exit 1, and matched fail-on policies use exit 3.
sandbox: Run normal, missing-input, and fail-on-denied commands with bundled files.

claim: Accepts user, group, and service-account subject forms.
sandbox: Evaluate fixtures once for each documented subject form.

claim: Derives standard Kubernetes service-account groups.
sandbox: Evaluate a service account against a namespace service-account group binding.

claim: Evaluates RoleBinding-to-Role grants.
sandbox: Inspect the bundled allowed secret check and its Role grant.

claim: Limits RoleBinding-to-ClusterRole grants to the binding namespace.
sandbox: Evaluate the same ClusterRole request inside and outside the RoleBinding namespace.

claim: Evaluates ClusterRoleBinding grants across namespaces.
sandbox: Evaluate the bundled ClusterRoleBinding in two namespaces.

claim: Handles exact and wildcard verbs, API groups, and resources.
sandbox: Evaluate a wildcard ClusterRole and inspect the preserved rule.

claim: Handles exact resources and Kubernetes */subresource rules.
sandbox: Evaluate a */scale rule against matching and nonmatching subresources.

claim: Handles resourceNames and named list or watch field selectors according to Kubernetes RBAC rules.
sandbox: Evaluate top-level create, list with and without a selector, and named get checks.

claim: Handles exact and trailing-wildcard non-resource URL rules.
sandbox: Evaluate matching and nonmatching URLs against a /healthz/* rule.

claim: Marks grants from aggregated ClusterRoles as uncertain.
sandbox: Evaluate a fixture whose granting ClusterRole has an aggregationRule.

claim: Records the Kubernetes server version in each report.
sandbox: Inspect the source metadata in the bundled demo packet.

claim: Records excluded authorizers and identity-provider limits in each report.
sandbox: Inspect the bundled packet limitations.

claim: Creates reusable snapshots without kubeconfig credentials.
where: landing page, README, and privacy page
sandbox: Collect through a controlled kubectl with a sentinel credential and parse the saved snapshot.

claim: Creates owner-only signing keys on Unix and refuses to overwrite them.
sandbox: Generate a key in a temporary directory, inspect mode 0600, and attempt replacement.

claim: Signs packet content and rejects changed fields or a different trusted signer.
sandbox: Generate two keys, sign once, verify with each trust reference, and add an unknown check field.

claim: Works with access limited to RBAC reads and version queries.
sandbox: Complete collection through a controlled kubectl that exposes only documented read operations.

claim: The browser demo uses fictional data in a separate session namespace and does not change real storage.
sandbox: Seed a real-storage value, use the demo, and inspect local and session storage.

claim: The site loads without analytics, trackers, CDN fonts, or third-party scripts.
where: landing page, README, and privacy page
sandbox: Record all demo-page requests in a fresh browser context and inspect loaded script and font origins.

claim: The guide and browser demo work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Use a dedicated browser context, wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and select a sample.

claim: Existing licenses stay in local storage, are verified at most daily, and never enter Cache Storage URLs.
sandbox: Mock verification, reload within one day, inspect storage, and scan every cached request URL.

claim: Field Kit sales are paused and the site accepts no payment.
where: landing page, README, privacy page, and terms
sandbox: Inspect the rendered site for the paused notice and absence of checkout or purchase actions.
